name: Lintel the Peach-Patch Cat
blurb: Lintel, a slim grey tabby-and-white cat with a faint peach patch on one hip, stretches out across every doorstep in the garden.

name: Rafter the Striped-Cap Cat
blurb: Rafter, a young brown tabby with a dark-striped cap, white muzzle and white paws, dozes with his chin resting on the garden gate.

name: Sill the White-Legged Cat
blurb: Sill, a grey-brown tabby with a white bib, white belly and long white legs, naps on the sunniest windowsill of the garden house.
